questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2020, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Indiana 9, Purdue 4 (through 2025). Latest: Indiana: 2025 vs. No. 11 Alabama 38–3, 2025 vs. No. 5 Oregon 56–22, 2025 vs. No. 10 Miami 27–21; Purdue: 2021 vs. No. 5 Michigan State 40–29, 2022 vs. No. 21 Minnesota 20–10, 2022 vs. No. 21 Illinois 31–24.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.
